snippet.title: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure - OFFICIAL DEMO RELEASE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Download on Steam Store:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3801590/Ponchyo_A_Platypus_Adventure

Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure is a charming 3D platformer collectathon full of adventure - and a little touch of nostalgia! Step into the shoes (Wait... do platypuses don't have shoes, right? No idea!) of Ponchyo the platypus! Collect coins and discover new furniture to decorate your home. The demo includes the first level, a few furnitures to collect for your house and one upgrade for Ponchyo!
